shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin holds above $64,000, displaying resilience amid risk-off sentiment, supported by continued ETF inflows. Some analysts project an $80,000 target for August.

Escalating US-Iran tensions are increasing risk aversion in global markets, pushing crude oil prices higher, and potentially delaying Federal Reserve interest rate cuts due to renewed inflation concerns.

Stablecoin regulations remain uncertain, with the GENIUS Act's implementing rules still pending a year after its signing. Additionally, France has moved to block the prediction market Polymarket, highlighting growing regulatory scrutiny.
Ethereum shows robust performance, supported by strong DeFi and staking activity. Prediction markets indicate high confidence that ETH will remain above $1,400.
MicroStrategy has further increased its Bitcoin holdings, now owning 843,775 BTC, indicating continued strong institutional interest in the asset.
